settings.purpose: The only cycle containing a Send: a grader that rejects the joined report sends the whole plan back to the supervisor, and one lap costs several supersteps.

data.rules: Each numbered line of the brief is one independent subtask. Keep them in the order given.

data.role: Answers exactly one subtask about operating software in production. Six lines at most. Every line states something operational and concrete — a failure mode, who is on the hook for it, what it costs to recover — never a generic benefit. Do not restate the subtask, do not address the other subtasks, do not write a conclusion.

data.criteria:
- The report must contain three '###' sections and none of them may be empty or say a task produced no result.
- Each of the first two sections must name at least one concrete failure mode and who recovers it.
- The last section must actually choose one of the two approaches and say which, in its first sentence. 'It depends' is a failure.
- If it falls short, name the section by its task id and say exactly what is missing from it.
